_legenda: English descriptions for desktop/funcoes.json (same keys). c = confirmed (tested on the device or seen in UI/app code); i = INFERRED (from name/context only)
misns/wifi_share_info: Guest network: on/off, name, password and security.
misns/wifi_share_switch: Local guest network switch used by the cloud; parameters unknown (code 1523). Use set_wifi_without_restart.
misystem/active: Triggers the speed-history refresh (used after the speed test).
misystem/arn_ignore: Ignores/releases a device flagged by the anti-intrusion feature.
misystem/arn_security: Security center: privacy protection, malicious-site firewall and virus-file firewall.
misystem/arn_security_switch: Security center: info = JSON with malicious_url_firewall, virus_file_firewall, privacy_protection (0/1); wifi_arn touches the MAC filter. Tested.
misystem/arn_status: Anti-intrusion (防蹭网): on/off, level and count of blocked attempts.
misystem/arn_switch: Anti-intrusion: open 0/1 (also turns the Wi-Fi MAC filter on/off, model mode 0 block / 1 allow list) and/or level.
misystem/c_backup: Creates a configuration backup file (keys = parts to include).
misystem/c_restore: Restores the chosen items of the uploaded backup (comma-separated keys); a restart is needed afterwards.
misystem/c_upload: Uploads a backup (multipart, file in the image field). Only reads the file: returns des.keys {key: description} to choose in c_restore.
misystem/channel_scan_result: Optimization result: 2G{cchannel current, cscore, schannel suggested, sscore (interference: lower is better), ranking, code 0 = ready}.
misystem/channel_scan_start: Starts the 2.4 GHz channel analysis (the app's Wi-Fi optimization); result in channel_scan_result after ~10 s.
misystem/check_status: DISK check state — unused on the AX1800.
misystem/devicelist: Known devices: name, MAC, IP, online, connection type (0 wired, 1 2.4 GHz, 2 5 GHz, 3 guest), speeds and permissions.
misystem/extendwifi_scanlist: Lists nearby networks for wireless repeater mode.
misystem/get_dev_bsd: Device band in unified Wi-Fi (mac) → bsd, mode.
misystem/get_usb_u3: USB 3.0 mode status (no effect on the AX1800, which has no USB).
misystem/http_status: Status of the router's HTTP interception (e.g. warning pages).
misystem/iperf: iperf server to measure local network speed.
misystem/led: LED status; with on=0/1 turns the device lights off/on.
misystem/messages: Bell notices: messages[{type 1 new version {version} / 3 5 GHz failure / 4 IP conflict {ip}, timestamp}], count.
misystem/minet_get_state: MiNet status (quick setup of Xiaomi devices); returns an error on this device.
misystem/net_diagnose_result: Result: status 1 ok, 2 problem (wan up/down, diagnose 111/112/113/114/678/633/101/691/100, dns), 3 undefined.
misystem/netacctl_set: Sets a device's internet access control.
misystem/newstatus: 2.4/5 GHz summary (name and connected clients). Warning: returns the 2.4 GHz password in the 'pssswd' field.
misystem/parctl_add: Creates a rule: mac, enable, frequency "1,2,3,4,5", timeseg "22:00-07:00"; returns id. Tested.
misystem/parctl_info: Parental control: device rules (mac) — id, enable, frequency [1..7], timeseg {from, to}.
misystem/parctl_set_filter: Sets the site filter (mac, mode none/black/white). Tested.
misystem/parctl_set_url: Adds (opt 0) or removes (opt 1) a site (mac, mode, url; newurl to replace). Tested.
misystem/parctl_update: Updates a rule (id, mac, enable, frequency, timeseg). Tested.
misystem/qos_dev_info: QoS limit of a specific device (needs parameters).
misystem/qos_guest: Guest network speed limit (percent, percent_up of the bandwidth).
misystem/qos_info: QoS settings: on/off, mode, bandwidth, guest network limit and per-device limits.
misystem/qos_info_new: Newer QoS summary used by the app (bandwidth, limits per MAC).
misystem/qos_limits: Per-device limits in KB/s (0 = no limit): data = JSON [{mac, maxup, maxdown}]. The official page calls qos_mode with the current mode afterwards.
misystem/qos_set_dev_info: Writes a device's QoS limit (used by the app).
misystem/qos_xq: Limit for the router's own traffic, as a fraction of the bandwidth (percent, percent_up); read in qos_info.local.
misystem/r_ip_conflict: Avoids the IP conflict with the upstream router by moving the LAN to the IP suggested in messages (type 4). Restarts the Wi-Fi.
misystem/repair_status: DISK repair state (not network) — unused on the AX1800.
misystem/router_common_status: Summary for the app: devices, WAN speed and USB.
misystem/set_band: Sets the contracted bandwidth (upload/download in Mbps) used by QoS.
misystem/set_channel: Applies channels (channel1 = 2.4 GHz, channel2 = 5 GHz); saved to the config; ~5 s without dropping the Wi-Fi (tested).
misystem/set_dev_bsd: Pins the device band (mac, mode); restarts the Wi-Fi.
misystem/set_sys_time: Sets the time zone (timezone, index) or the time (time 'YYYY-MM-DD hh:mm:ss').
misystem/smartvpn_info: VPN smart split: switch, mode (1 by address, 2 by device), ulist, mlist, name{mac: name}.
misystem/smartvpn_mac: Adds (opt 0) or removes (opt 1) devices from smart split.
misystem/smartvpn_switch: Turns smart split on/off and chooses the mode.
misystem/smartvpn_url: Adds (opt 0) or removes (opt 1) an address from smart split.
misystem/speed_test_result: Result of the app's speed test.
misystem/start_portscan: Scans a device's open ports (ip, mac).
misystem/start_weakdetect: Tests weak FTP/SSH/Telnet passwords on a device (ip, mac).
misystem/status: Overall status: uptime, CPU, memory, device count, WAN traffic (current, peak, total) and hardware.
misystem/sys_log: Generates a system-log package and returns the download path.
misystem/sys_time: Router time, time zone (timezone + option index) and Mesh role (whc_cap main / whc_re node).
misystem/topo_graph: Mesh network topology: main router and nodes (name, IP, location, model).
misystem/usb_u3: Turns USB 3.0 on/off (enable) — no effect on the AX1800.
misystem/vas_info: Value-added services (Xiaomi ads/plug-ins); empty on this device.
misystem/web_access_info: Admin access control: on/off and list of allowed MACs.
misystem/web_access_opt: Turns access control on/off and adds/removes allowed MACs.
xqdatacenter/request: Generic numbered-command channel ('api' in the payload) used by the UI and the cloud.
xqnetdetect/nettb: Quick device → router → internet test: error 0 = ok.
xqnetwork/add_mesh_node: Adds a node to the Mesh. locate = room name in Chinese (客厅, 主卧, 次卧, 书房, 厨房, 办公室, 地下室, 卫生间, 阁楼, 阳台, 餐厅).
xqnetwork/check_wan_type: Detects the connection type on the WAN port: 1 PPPoE, 2 DHCP, 3 static IP, 99 no cable, other = unknown (returns 0 with PPPoE connected).
xqnetwork/ddns: DDNS services: on (service on), list[{id, servicename, domain, enabled, status 0 error/1 ok/2 connecting, lastupdate, wanip, error}].
xqnetwork/ddns_switch: Turns the router's DDNS service on/off.
xqnetwork/disable_ap: Leaves wireless repeater mode and goes back to router (restores previous settings). Returns lanip and ssid.
xqnetwork/disable_lan_ap: Leaves wired repeater mode and goes back to router. Returns ip.
xqnetwork/dmz: DMZ: status (1 = on; 0/2 = off), device ip, router lanip.
xqnetwork/edit_device: Adds (option=0) or removes (option=1) a MAC from the filter list.
xqnetwork/get_addnode_status: Node add progress: 0 done, 1 connecting, 2 syncing, 3 expanding (1–2 min), 4 failed.
xqnetwork/get_miotrelay_switch: Quick connect (畅快连) status for Mi Home devices.
xqnetwork/get_son_backhaul_mode: 'Priority for many devices' (多终端接入优先) status.
xqnetwork/lan_dhcp: DHCP server settings (range, lease, DNS, gateway).
xqnetwork/mac_bind: Creates IP reservations (data = JSON [{ip, mac, name}]). With an already reserved MAC, it replaces the name and IP (tested 2026-11-09) — this is how the panel edits a reservation.
xqnetwork/mac_clone: Clones a MAC address on the WAN.
xqnetwork/macbind_info: IP reservations (static DHCP) and device list.
xqnetwork/manually_add: Manually adds a device (name + MAC) to the filter list.
xqnetwork/mode: Work mode: 0 = router, 1 = wireless repeater, 2 = wired repeater.
xqnetwork/portforward: Forwarding rules: ftype 1 = ports (srcport, destip, destport), 2 = ranges (srcport {f, t}, destip). proto 1 TCP, 2 UDP, 3 both.
xqnetwork/pppoe_catch: Captures the PPPoE user/password from an old router connected to the WAN.
xqnetwork/scan_mesh_node: Scans for available Mesh nodes: list[{ssid, mac, rssi}] (rssi < -60 = too far). Takes a few seconds.
xqnetwork/set_all_wifi: Unified Wi-Fi: bsd 1 (only on1/ssid1/pwd1/encryption1/channel1/bandwidth1/hidden1/txpwr1) or bsd 0 (also the …2 fields). Restarts the Wi-Fi.
xqnetwork/set_lan_ap: Switches to wired repeater (access point; WAN connected to another router). Returns the new ip.
xqnetwork/set_lan_dhcp: Changes or turns off the DHCP server.
xqnetwork/set_peer_wifi_auto_ap_mode: Automatic access-point setup between Mesh nodes.
xqnetwork/set_son_backhaul_mode: Turns priority for many devices on/off (mode).
xqnetwork/set_wan: Changes the internet connection (PPPoE, DHCP or static IP).
xqnetwork/set_wan6: IPv6 mode (POST): wanType=native (passes the ISP prefix through, which changes on every reconnection), nat (NAT6: home network with fixed prefix fd00:6868:6868::/64) or static; autosetipv6=0/1 (automatic/manual DNS), dns1, dns2.
xqnetwork/set_wifi: Changes a Wi-Fi network (wifiIndex 1=2.4 GHz, 2=5 GHz, 3=guest): name, password, security, channel, width, hidden, power; and weak-signal roaming.
xqnetwork/set_wifi_ap: Switches to wireless repeater of the given network (usage seen on the official page). Optional: nssid/nencryption/npassword for its own Wi-Fi. Returns ip and ssid.
xqnetwork/set_wifi_ax: Wi-Fi 6 on (ax=1) or Wi-Fi 5 compatibility mode (ax=0).
xqnetwork/set_wifi_macfilter: Turns the MAC filter on/off and sets its mode (model, enable).
xqnetwork/set_wifi_txpwr: Changes the power of BOTH bands at once (txpwr max/mid/min) in ~5 s without restarting the Wi-Fi (tested 2026-11-09). The screen that used it was removed from the firmware.
xqnetwork/set_wifi_without_restart: Changes only the given fields without restarting Wi-Fi. wifiIndex=3 + on=1/0 turns the guest network on/off; wifiIndex=1/2 + hidden=1/0 hides/shows the SSID (not mirrored to the Mesh node).
xqnetwork/wan_info: Internet: type (PPPoE/DHCP/static), IP, gateway, DNS, MTU, connected time, IPv6 and MAC in use.
xqnetwork/wifi_detail_all: Full Wi-Fi settings per band (name, password, security, channel, width, power, hidden, Wi-Fi 6, MU-MIMO, roaming) and unified Wi-Fi.
xqnetwork/wifi_list: Scans neighbouring networks (~12–15 s): ssid, bssid, band 2g/5g, channel, signal %, rssi, encryption, enctype (no width). Used by wireless-repeater mode and by the Zigbee-aware channel search.
xqnetwork/wifi_macfilter_info: Wi-Fi MAC filter: on/off, mode (blocklist/allowlist) and list.
xqnetwork/wifiap_signal: Signal quality to the upstream router (node/repeater).
xqsmarthome/request_smartcontroller: Scenes/schedules engine (the app's scheduled reboot). Parameter format not discovered.
xqsystem/check_rom_update: Checks Xiaomi's servers for a firmware update.
xqsystem/country_code: Current Wi-Fi region and options (China, Hong Kong, Taiwan, Korea, Europe).
xqsystem/device_list_zigbee: Zigbee devices of routers with a built-in gateway (not applicable to the AX1800).
xqsystem/flash_permission: Checks whether firmware flashing is allowed.
xqsystem/get_languages: Original UI languages (Simplified Chinese, Traditional HK/TW).
xqsystem/init_info: Public router information (model, version, region); answers without login.
xqsystem/login: Admin login (nonce + sha1); returns the session token.
xqsystem/oneclick_get_remote_token: Token for remote cloud access (app binding).
xqsystem/reset: Factory reset (format 0/1). On a wired Mesh node: it comes back as a plain router and, after a power cycle, re-joins the Mesh by itself (tested 10/11).
xqsystem/router_bind_ok: Confirms binding the router to the Xiaomi account (used by the app via the cloud).
xqsystem/set_country_code: Changes the Wi-Fi region (channels and power).
xqsystem/set_mac_filter: Blocks (wan=0) or allows (wan=1) a device's internet access.
xqsystem/set_name_password: Changes the admin password (proprietary AES encryption).
xqsystem/set_vpn: Adds (WITHOUT the id field — any id, even empty, becomes an edit) or edits (with id) a VPN server. Editing changes the id. Tested.
xqsystem/system_info: Model, version, firmware channel, uptime and name.
xqsystem/upgrade_status: Progress of an ongoing firmware update.
xqsystem/upload_log: Uploads the system logs to Xiaomi.
xqsystem/upload_rom: Uploads a firmware file for a manual update.
xqsystem/upnp: UPnP: status 1/0 and list[{protocol, name, ip, cport, rport}] of open ports.
xqsystem/usbmode: Prepares USB for an update (no effect on the AX1800).
xqsystem/usbservice: Turns USB services on/off during an update.
xqsystem/vpn: VPN servers: list[{id, oname, proto pptp/l2tp, server, username, password}], current{id, auto, …}.
xqsystem/vpn_status: VPN state: 0 connected, 1 connecting, 2 failed, 3 disconnected, 4 not enabled; uptime; errcode/errmsg.
xqsystem/wps_status: WPS state: 0 idle, 1 waiting, 2 connected (device{mac, company}), 3–7 failed/expired.
xqnetwork/add_server: Adds a DDNS service. Provider id: 1 No-IP, 2 Oray, 3 3322.org, 4 Dyn.
xqnetwork/ddns_edit: Edits a DDNS service (same parameters as add_server).
xqnetwork/get_server: One DDNS service's data (username, password, domain, checkinterval, forceinterval, enabled).
xqnetwork/server_switch: Enables/disables a DDNS service (only one active at a time).
xqnetwork/add_redirect: Adds a port rule (POST name, proto, sport, ip, dport). No edit on this firmware: force is ignored (code 1608) — delete and re-add. Takes effect after redirect_apply. Tested.
xqnetwork/add_range_redirect: Adds a port range rule. Takes effect after redirect_apply.
xqnetwork/delete_redirect: Removes a port or range rule (port = external port or the range's start port).
xqnetwork/redirect_apply: Applies the forwarding rules (the official page's "保存并生效" button).
xqnetwork/set_dmz: Turns DMZ on for an IP (POST ip). Refused (code 1610) while any port-forwarding rule exists. Tested.
xqnetwork/dmz_off: Turns DMZ off (the official page calls dmz_reload afterwards).
xqsystem/set_vpnauto: Connect the VPN when the router starts (auto 1/0).
misystem/mi_vpn: Turns "Xiaomi services via VPN" on/off (the official page disconnects the VPN first).
misystem/parctl_get_filter: Device site filter: urlfilter{mode none/black/white, count}.
xqnetdetect/detect: The app's "health check": cpuavg, memoryuse, cputemp, link, wan, gateway, dnsstatus, ping, wifi (password strength), speed, disk (params simple, target; simple=1 gave error 500).
misystem/check_ip_conflict: Checks for an IP conflict with the upstream router: ip_conflict "0" = none.
misystem/hwnat_status: Hardware NAT acceleration: status 1 on / 0 off (0 on both routers on 2026-11-10). The real offload is Qualcomm NSS/ECM via /proc/xqfp, enabled when QoS is off (1.0.399 teardown).
misystem/hwnat_switch: Turns hardware NAT on/off (on 0/1) and REBOOTS; on this model the status stays 0 afterwards (tested 2026-11-10). There is no init.d/hwnat: NSS/ECM offload is owned by QoS via /proc/xqfp/open_fastpath_v3 (1.0.399 teardown).
misystem/get_mesh_device_info: Mesh node info: does NOT work on this model (error 500).
misystem/set_mesh_device: Removes (op 1) or restarts (op 2) a Mesh node (mesh_mac). No effect on this model (tested 2026-11-10; whcal/whc_ual absent in firmware 1.0.399).
misystem/get_mesh_metric: Mesh metric: does NOT work on this model (code 127 — the whcal command is not in firmware 1.0.399; Mesh uses Qualcomm repacd/lbd).
xqnetdetect/ping_test: Ping from the router (url) → result 1 = reachable.
xqnetdetect/sys_status: Quick check: status 0 ok, 1 CPU/memory > 90 % or temperature > 70 °C, 2 no WAN link (returns 2 on this model even with internet).
xqnetwork/wifi_up: Turns a band's radio on (wifiIndex 1/2) without changing the config.
xqnetwork/wifi_down: Turns a band's radio off (wifiIndex 1/2) without changing the config.
xqnetwork/wan_statistics: Accumulated internet traffic: download, upload (bytes), current and peak speeds.
xqnetwork/devices_statistics: Accumulated traffic of all devices: statistics[{mac, devname, download, upload (bytes), max…speed, online (s)}].
xqsystem/set_device_nickname: Renames a device (mac, name; owner and device optional).
xqsystem/get_sys_avg_load: System load: on this model it only returns processCount (cores).
xqsystem/start_dropbear: Would start the SSH server (dropbear). Blocked by design: in the 1.0.399 teardown, init.d/dropbear returns early unless the version channel is NOT 'release' and nvram ssh_en=1 — ours is 'release', so there is no working SSH endpoint.
xqsystem/stop_dropbear: Stops the router's SSH server. (controller stopDropbear; untested).
xqsystem/is_dropbear_started: Tells whether the SSH server is running. (controller isDropbearStarted; untested).
xqsystem/app_limit: Xunlei/Kuaipan app limits: does NOT work on this model (error 500).
xqsystem/set_app_limit: Sets Xunlei/Kuaipan app limits (xlmaxdownload, xlmaxupload, kpmaxdownload, kpmaxupload) — no useful effect outside China.
xqsystem/wifi_log: Wi-Fi log: on this model it returns only {code: 0}, no data.
xqsystem/smart_shutdown: Would power the router off and back on after delay1/delay2 MINUTES (XQFunction: sleep 60×delay1; uhbn 2 delay2). No effect on this model (tested 2026-11-10; the uhbn binary is not in firmware 1.0.399).
